description:
Project Overview

This Wageningen postdoctoral position examines governance arrangements that support sustainability transitions in farming systems. The work is hosted by Animal Production Systems and includes research connected to ReGeNL.

Research Position Overview

Study public and private governance, certification, standards and sustainability indicators. Work with stakeholders on regenerative agriculture, contribute to policy-oriented projects and proposals, and take part in education where relevant.

Research Areas

  • Regenerative agriculture
  • Farming governance
  • Sustainability indicators

Eligibility and Requirements
